description: This file defines data structures and a loader related to cost usage summaries for a gateway, including Codable models for serialization and a static method to asynchronously load data.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageTotals
classes.description: Contains aggregate cost and token usage data.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageDay
classes.description: Represents daily cost and usage data, including computed properties for each metric.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageSummary
classes.description: Encapsulates overall usage summary including daily breakdowns and totals.

classes.name: CostUsageFormatting
classes.description: Utility for formatting cost and token count values into strings.

classes.name: CostUsageLoader
classes.description: Asynchronous loader that fetches the cost usage summary data from a backend service.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Loads the usage cost summary asynchronously via a network request.
